analysis_scope_and_positioning: Conceptual and cross-study protocol-comparability synthesis: formalizes mathematical conditions (Proposition 1), operational estimator vs. proxy boundaries, and 4 traceable re-analyses of published benchmark tables without claiming new end-to-end model training or universal leaderboard aggregation.

formal_proposition_1.statement: Proposition 1 (Joint Feasibility System of Static Recall-Miss Abstention, Conditional Reduction, Selective-Risk Counterexample, and Three-Way Recovery Separation)

full_five_constraint_system: (1) Unconditional task risk across Omega_inv (including unperturbed baseline (q, C) at p_miss=0): r_0 <= eps_task and (1 - p_miss)*r_0 + p_miss*c_abs <= eps_task
(2) Semantic distributional stability: D_TV(P_S(Phi_T | q, C), P_S(Phi_T | q', C')) <= delta_stab
(3) Answered-subset selective risk: R_sel(Pi_abs) = r_0 <= alpha_r (for p_miss < 1)
(5) Safety & budget compliance: P_S(tau_{1:T} notin B_T) <= eta_sec and c_phys(Pi_abs) <= B
explicit_simplification_assumptions: (A2) Conditional reader distribution invariance on successful retrievals: P_S(Phi_T | q', D_1, W_T^loc != empty) = P_S(Phi_T | q, C), so P_S' = (1 - p_miss)*P_S + p_miss*delta_abs and D_TV(P_S, P_S') = p_miss
part_i_full_joint_system_and_conditional.exact_iff_condition_under_A1_A3: Under (A1)-(A3), static abstention Pi_abs satisfies both Eq. (2) and Eq. (5) across Omega_inv(q, C) (which contains the identity transition (q, C) at p_miss = 0) iff r_0 <= alpha_r, r_0 <= eps_task, and p_miss <= p_tol(r_0) := min(tau_task(r_0, c_abs, eps_task), delta_stab, 1 - tau_cov_r), where tau_task = (eps_task - r_0)/(c_abs - r_0) if c_abs > r_0 and 1 if c_abs <= r_0 (if one evaluated only a single perturbed transition at fixed p_miss > 0 without requiring (q, C) in Omega_inv, the branch c_abs < r_0 would allow r_0 > eps_task whenever p_miss >= (r_0 - eps_task)/(r_0 - c_abs)).

results.reason: Selective risk r_0 = 0.20 > alpha_r = 0.10 violates Eq. (5), proving r_0 <= alpha_r is a necessary prerequisite.

three_non_equivalent_statements.1_static_inadmissibility: When r_0 <= min(alpha_r, eps_task) and p_miss > p_tol(r_0), static abstention Pi_abs violates at least one constraint in Eq. (2) or Eq. (5).
three_non_equivalent_statements.2_constraint_feasible_recovery_existence: A re-retrieval action with recovery probability p_rec restores joint satisfaction of Eqs. (2) and (5) iff it is budget-feasible (c_phys(Pi_abs) + p_miss*c_phys(a_1) <= B) and reachability-capable (p_miss*(1 - p_rec) <= p_tol(r_0), i.e., p_rec >= 1 - p_tol(r_0)/p_miss).
three_non_equivalent_statements.3_bellman_voi_strict_optimality: In the Lagrangian dual Bellman objective (Eqs. 4 and 9) with dimensionless normalized cost C_op(a_1) = mu_cost^T (c_phys(a_1)/B), re-retrieval strictly improves the dual value over immediate refusal iff VoI(a_1) = p_rec*(c_abs + lam_r*alpha_r + nu_r - (1+lam_r)*r_0) > C_op(a_1).

part_iii_gold_present_denominator_bias.identity: E_S[L_T | Omega_inv] = (1 - p_miss)*R_gold + p_miss*R_miss; pre-filtering to gold-present queries (p_miss -> 0, as in RAAT §4.1) biases estimated risk by -p_miss*(R_miss - R_gold).

operational_estimator_taxonomy.formal_quantity: Property 1 End-to-End Task Risk: sup_{Omega_inv} E_S[L_T(Phi_T(Y_T), Z*) | q', C'] <= eps_task (Eq. 2a)
operational_estimator_taxonomy.direct_operational_estimator: Generation-phase worst-case task-score lower bound min_{P_k' in A(P_k, k')} M(y_hat_{P_k'}, y*) >= tau (Certifiable Accuracy cacc at tau=1 in RobustRAG, lifted to corpus edits |C' Delta C| <= m under frozen retriever theta_R and preserved benign rank order); or empirical maximum loss across K paired perturbations (q', C') in Omega_inv_hat with refusal scored at L_T(abs, Z*) = c_abs > 0.
operational_estimator_taxonomy.directional_proxy_metrics: Dataset-mean EM/F1 under synthetic noise ratios (RGB, RECOMP, Chain-of-Note), conditional gold-present EM drop (RAAT), Resilience Rate P(Y_RAG=z* | y_theta=z*) (xRAG), and RAD = 100*|ARA-Add|/|ARA| (Park & Lee). These average over finite test sets or condition on closed-book/gold-present subsets rather than bounding the full-pipeline supremum.
operational_estimator_taxonomy.untested_when_using_proxy_alone: Retriever recall misses (when pre-filtered to gold-present queries in RAAT), worst-case adversarial perturbations (when averaging over benign noise), and semantic distribution drift among distinct error classes.

operational_estimator_taxonomy.formal_quantity: Property 1 Semantic Distributional Invariance: sup_{Omega_inv} D_TV(P_S(Phi_T | q, C), P_S(Phi_T | q', C')) <= delta_stab (Eq. 2b)
operational_estimator_taxonomy.direct_operational_estimator: Two-sample plug-in TV distance 0.5 * sum_{z in Z_sem} |P_hat_M(z | q, C) - Q_hat_M^{(k)}(z | q_k', C_k')| over a pre-fixed or split-sample semantic partition Z_sem = {z*, Z_0, e_1, ..., e_J, e_other, abs} (C_sem = |Z_sem|) keeping distinct non-entailing errors e_1 != e_2 separate. Across two independent M-draw samples (2M independent draws total, each with bounded-difference sensitivity c_i = 1/M so sum c_i^2 = 2/M and two-sided McDiarmid tail 2*exp(-M*t^2)) and K = |Omega_hat_K| tested perturbations, simultaneous 1 - delta estimation error is bounded by eps_stat(M, C_sem, K, delta) + 2*eps_bar_NLI where eps_stat = sqrt((C_sem-1)/M) + sqrt(ln(2K/delta)/M) and eps_bar_NLI is the Clopper-Pearson upper bound on per-draw NLI misclustering probability P(phi_hat_NLI(Y) != phi*(Y)) (requiring M >= (sqrt(C_sem-1) + sqrt(ln(2K/delta)))^2 / eps_0^2; whereas post-hoc sample-adaptive NLI clustering on the pooled 2M evaluation draws is an exploratory drift diagnostic).
operational_estimator_taxonomy.directional_proxy_metrics: Coarse 4-label behavioral TV over {z*, Z_0, other-error, abs} (which satisfies D_TV(g_# P, g_# Q) <= D_TV(P, Q) by the data-processing inequality), small-M pilot draws (M in [10, 20]), single-draw flip rate 1 - A->A (Park & Lee Table 8), or self-consistency agreement.
operational_estimator_taxonomy.untested_when_using_proxy_alone: Pointwise accuracy and coarse error collapsing hide semantic drift across distinct error modes: over (z*, e_1, e_2), P=(0.80, 0.20, 0.00) and Q=(0.80, 0.00, 0.20) have fine-grained D_TV(P, Q) = 0.20 > 0, whereas merging e_1, e_2 into other-error collapses both to (0.80, 0.20) with coarse TV = 0.

operational_estimator_taxonomy.formal_quantity: Property 2 Counterfactual Update Risk & Plasticity: E[L_T | Omega_upd] <= eps_upd, P_S(Z* | q', D') - P_0(q') >= gamma_resp*(1 - P_0(q')), P_S(Z_0 | Omega_upd^conf) <= delta_prior (Eq. 3)
operational_estimator_taxonomy.direct_operational_estimator: Paired corpus-state transition (q, C_0) -> (q, C_1) where authoritative, corroborated evidence under closed-form query-time reliability rho(d', t_q) > rho(d_0, t_q) (where temporal supersession closes t_end(d_0) so rho(d_0, t_q)=0 < rho(d', t_q)) shifts W_T^ref from Z_0 to Z* != Z_0: Context Adherence Rate ConR / R_Ad estimates P_S(Z* | q', D') and Memorization Rate MemR estimates P_S(Z_0 | Omega_upd^conf), while separating stipulated fiat entity swaps (NQ-Swap, ConFiQA) from provenance-verified updates.
operational_estimator_taxonomy.directional_proxy_metrics: xRAG Boost Rate P(Y_RAG=z* | y_theta!=z*) on a static corpus. Boost Rate measures whether retrieval corrects closed-book ignorance on a static fact, which motivates external context reliance but does NOT construct a paired authoritative state transition Z_0 -> Z* overriding an existing belief.
operational_estimator_taxonomy.untested_when_using_proxy_alone: Static closed-book-to-RAG comparisons do not test whether the system overrides a high-confidence stale parametric prior (Z_0 -> Z*), and stipulated entity-swap benchmarks without provenance controls do not test whether the reader rejects low-authority misinformation.

operational_estimator_taxonomy.formal_quantity: Property 3 Admissible Risk-Coverage Control & VoI Routing: E[L_T | a_T=ans] <= alpha_r, P(a_T=ans) >= tau_cov,r under budget B (Eqs. 4, 5, 9)
operational_estimator_taxonomy.direct_operational_estimator: Simultaneous FWER-calibrated threshold selection over grid/lattice Lambda on exchangeable calibration split D_cal,r \ D_init,r using one-sided exact binomial p-values p_lambda^{bin} = P(Bin(M_lambda, alpha_r) <= K_lambda) for R_hat_lambda <= alpha_r (and 1 otherwise) on binary 0-1 losses, or randomized Bernoulli rounding B_i ~ Bernoulli(L_{T,i}) and one-sided truncated Hoeffding-Bentkus p-values p_lambda^{HB} = min(exp(-M_lambda*KL_Ber(R_hat_lambda || alpha_r)), e*P(Bin(M_lambda, alpha_r) <= ceil(M_lambda*R_hat_lambda)), 1) for M_lambda >= 1 and R_hat_lambda <= alpha_r (and p_lambda^{HB} = 1 whenever M_lambda = 0 or R_hat_lambda > alpha_r) on continuous losses L_T in [0, 1], paired with Sequential Graphical Testing (SGT in BalanceRAG; Bretz et al. 2009) or RCPS/LTT correction (Bates et al. 2021; Angelopoulos et al. 2025) at level 1 - delta.
operational_estimator_taxonomy.directional_proxy_metrics: Empirical selective accuracy-coverage curves without finite-sample alpha_r calibration (Sufficient Context Fig. 4), marginal split-conformal set coverage P(Y* in Gamma_alpha) >= 1 - alpha (URAG), or standalone uncalibrated ECE/AUROC.
operational_estimator_taxonomy.untested_when_using_proxy_alone: Empirical selective accuracy-coverage curves and marginal multi-answer set coverage do not certify finite-sample singleton error <= alpha_r; and under Proposition 1, static abstention on solvable recall misses violates Eq. (2) or Eq. (5) whenever r_0 > min(alpha_r, eps_task) or p_miss > p_tol(r_0).

paired_empirical_reanalyses.compared_methods: RECOMP (Extractive 75-tok vs. Abstractive T5-Large 64-tok, v1 Table 2) vs. xRAG (1-tok bridge, Table 11 & Table 3)
paired_empirical_reanalyses.single_metric_illusion: On single-hop NQ, RECOMP Abstractive (37.04 EM at 36 tok), RECOMP Extractive (36.57 EM at 37 tok), and xRAG (39.10 EM at 1 tok) appear similarly effective at extreme compression (9-18x to 175x), and xRAG improves Resilience Rate from 74.1% to 82.3% (+8.2 pp).
paired_empirical_reanalyses.coupled_framework_diagnosis: Audit of compression granularity, token-budget confounding, and original-study dual-axis metrics: (1) in RECOMP Table 2, 75-token extractive selection (30.40 EM, -2.40 pp) vs. 64-token distilled T5-Large abstractive compression (28.20 EM, -4.60 pp; GPT-3.5 teacher 107 tok / 31.60 EM) on HotpotQA is not token-budget-matched (confounding compression paradigm with an 11-token reduction and student distillation), so the larger multi-hop drop is consistent with bridge-entity omission as a mechanistic hypothesis rather than an isolated causal proof; (2) as originally diagnosed by xRAG (§6.1, Table 11), collapsing 175.1 tokens into 1 embedding token raises Resilience (+8.2 pp) while depressing Boost Rate from 29.5% to 22.2% (-7.3 pp).

property_status.Property_1_Stability: Directional proxy only (single-draw EM drop / Resilience; fine-grained D_TV untested)
property_status.Property_2_Responsiveness: Directional proxy only in xRAG (static Boost -7.3 pp; provenance-warranted Z_0->Z* untested)
property_status.Property_3_Control: Partial proxy (null-gate tested in RECOMP; calibrated alpha_r and VoI untested)

paired_empirical_reanalyses.compared_methods: Base LLaMA2-7B-Chat vs. Prompt / CAD / IRCAN vs. RAAT vs. Parenting (Parenting Table 1, p. 8, on SQuAD2.0-Eval, RGB, and KNOT)
paired_empirical_reanalyses.single_metric_illusion: Evaluated on context adherence (R_Ad) alone on RGB, IRCAN (72.50%) and CAD (70.00%) outperform Base (68.00%) and appear superior to RAAT (49.50%); evaluated on noise robustness (R_Ro) alone on RGB, RAAT (41.00%) outperforms Base (29.50%), IRCAN (20.00%), and CAD (16.00%).
paired_empirical_reanalyses.coupled_framework_diagnosis: Synthesizing the original dual-axis evaluation of Parenting (Table 1) with our provenance-warrant boundary (Sec. 5.1): Parenting Table 1 directly demonstrates on identical LLaMA2-7B-Chat backbones that single-axis adherence methods (CAD: 70.00% R_Ad / 16.00% R_Ro; IRCAN: 72.50% / 20.00%) collapse R_Ro relative to Base (68.00% / 29.50%), whereas noise-only RAAT (49.50% / 41.00%) drops below Base on R_Ad, and subspace-decoupled Parenting improves both (79.50% / 45.50%). Our framework adds the provenance boundary separating fiat entity-swap compliance on SQuAD2.0-Eval from authority-warranted responsiveness (rho(d') > rho(d_0) in Eq. 3).

property_status.Property_1_Stability: Partial empirical proxy: single-draw noise accuracy R_Ro tested on RGB; semantic distribution drift D_TV and privilege boundary B_T untested
property_status.Property_2_Responsiveness: Proxy only: stipulated counterfactual entity-swap compliance R_Ad tested on SQuAD2.0-Eval/RGB; provenance-warranted update (rho(d') > rho(d_0) in Eq. 3) untested

paired_empirical_reanalyses.compared_methods: RAAT on RAG-Bench (Table 2: 83.07 -> 82.10 EM) vs. RGB Stress Test (Table 1: 96.33 -> 76.00% Acc) vs. Chain-of-Note on NQ/TQA/WebQ (Tables 2-3)
paired_empirical_reanalyses.single_metric_illusion: Surface comparison suggests RAAT nearly eliminates counterfactual noise degradation (-0.97 pp EM), whereas RGB and Chain-of-Note still suffer 15-25 pp degradation at high noise ratios.
paired_empirical_reanalyses.coupled_framework_diagnosis: C1-C5 protocol alignment corrects three non-comparable experimental denominators: (1) RAAT (§4.1) pre-filters test queries to those with >=2 gold passages in top-k (conditioning on retrieval recall = 1) and compares against unadapted LLaMA2-7B (51.80 -> 38.37 EM, -13.43 pp) and golden-only fine-tuned RALM_golden (74.03 -> 65.40 EM, -8.63 pp); (2) Chain-of-Note evaluates both unfiltered DPR top-k (Table 2, where retrieval recall is 64.2-89.9%) and controlled noise ratios up to 100% (Table 3, where gold support is completely absent at 100% noise); and (3) RGB scores lenient substring match on recent news entities.

property_status.Property_1_Stability: Proxy comparison: conditional gold-present EM stability (RAAT) vs. unfiltered end-to-end EM stability (CoN Table 2)
property_status.Property_3_Control: Partial proxy: unknown rejection tested in CoN at 100% noise; untested in RAAT

paired_empirical_reanalyses.compared_methods: Static Sufficiency Abstention (Sufficient Context / Park & Lee Unans Prompt) vs. VoI-Routed Corrective Search (CRAG / CtrlA) under Paraphrase Recall Miss (W_T^loc = empty != W_T^ref = {z*})
paired_empirical_reanalyses.single_metric_illusion: On queries where initial retrieval misses the gold passage (32% of NQ in Park & Lee Table 3), abstaining reduces answered-subset hallucination rate and improves conditional selective accuracy (Property 3 Eq. 5).
paired_empirical_reanalyses.coupled_framework_diagnosis: Under Proposition 1 (with baseline P_S(abs|q,C)=0 and invariant conditional answer distribution P_ans), static abstention on solvable recall misses (W_T^loc = empty != W_T^ref = {z*}) satisfies Eqs. (2) and (5) iff r_0 <= min(alpha_r, eps_task) and p_miss <= p_tol(r_0) = min(tau_task(r_0, c_abs, eps_task), delta_stab, 1 - tau_cov,r) (if r_0=0.20 > alpha_r=0.10, Eq. 5 is violated even when p_miss=0.05 <= 0.10; whereas for r_0=0, p_miss=0.05, c_abs=0.20 => E[L_T]=0.01 <= 0.02, D_TV=0.05 <= 0.10, Cov=0.95 >= 0.90, R_sel=0 <= 0.10). When r_0 <= min(alpha_r, eps_task) and p_miss > p_tol(r_0), we distinguish (a) static constraint violation, (b) existence of a budget-feasible, reachability-capable recovery policy (p_rec >= 1 - p_tol(r_0)/p_miss), and (c) strict single-step optimality in the dual Bellman objective (VoI > C_op in Eq. 9). Moreover, Sufficient Context Fig. 4 improves empirical selective accuracy-coverage curves without calibrating a finite-sample risk bound alpha_r.

property_status.Property_1_Stability: Feasible under static abstention iff r_0 <= min(alpha_r, eps_task) and p_miss <= p_tol(r_0) (under A1-A3)
property_status.Property_3_Control: Separates empirical acc.-cov. curves (Sufficient Context) from SGT/HB FWER-calibrated risk <= alpha_r (BalanceRAG) and normative Bellman VoI routing
